question: Which among the following is a tributary of river Narmada?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tawa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tawa**:-

 
 
• **The Tawa River is a tributary of the Narmada River in central India. **
 
• It is the longest tributary of the Narmada, with a length of 172 kilometers.
 
• The Tawa River originates in the Mahadeo hills of the Satpura Range in the Chhindwara district of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **It flows north and west through Betul district before joining the Narmada River in Hoshangabad district.**
